title: Semiabelian group-space fibres, cyclic torsion sheaf and constant labels
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme and $N$ an algebraic space with its natural commutative group law $H$ [def-sfb-smooth-integral-group-space]. Its group-valued functor of points $H(T)=N(T)$ has the given multiplication and restriction maps. We say that $H$ has semiabelian geometric fibres if for every algebraically closed field $K$ in the scheme universe and $s:\operatorname{Spec}K\to S$, the restricted group functor is isomorphic to that of a commutative group scheme $G/K$ [def-sc-group-scheme] having semiabelian geometric fibres [def-sfb-semiabelian-geometric-fibres]. Restriction is precomposition by the base-composition functor $\mathit{Sch}/K\to\mathit{Sch}/S$ [def-pc-base-change]. For $j:V\to S$, say $H$ is abelian on $V$ if its restricted group functor is represented by a proper smooth group scheme over $V$ with connected geometric fibres. For $n\in\mathbf N$, define its torsion presheaf on $S_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] by $T\mapsto\{x\in N(T):nx=0\}$, additively, with its canonical $\mathbf Z/n\mathbf Z$-module structure. This is a sheaf; denote it $N[n]$. The values and coefficient ring are lifted to the coefficient universe without changing their elements or operations. Define $L_{S,n,r}$ as the constant module sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] of $(\mathbf Z/n\mathbf Z)^r$, including $r=0$. For etale $j$, the comparison $j^*L_{S,n,r}\cong L_{V,n,r}$ is the canonical constant-sheaf inverse-image comparison [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], identifying inverse image with site restriction via its adjunction to direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. For a base isomorphism $h:S\cong S'$ and group-functor isomorphism $H\cong h^*H'$, the canonical torsion map $N[n]\to h^*N'[n]$ applies that isomorphism sectionwise. Constant labels are transported by the identity comparison.
